name: Psychic Paper
blocked_sentences: As this Equipment becomes attached to a creature, choose a creature card name and a creature type.
Equipped creature has ward {1}, it can't be blocked, and its name and creature type are the last chosen name and creature type.

needs.what: an 'as this Equipment becomes attached to a creature' replacement that runs choices (choose_card_name restricted to creature cards, choose_type of creature types) each time it attaches, storing the chosen values on the Equipment so later attachments overwrite them ('the last chosen')
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no becomes-attached event (only self_enters, permanent_enters, etc.), and an 'as' choice must happen as the attachment occurs, not as a trigger; choose_card_name/choose_type only bind for the resolving effect, not as persistent state on the permanent

needs.what: a static that sets the equipped creature's name and its creature type to values chosen and stored on the source (name and creature-type layer-4/text-changing characteristic override read from the source's remembered choice)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: rename is a one-shot op, not a static; set_creature_types exists as a static but cannot read a chosen type remembered on the source, and no static sets a name
